script_text: This week the cosmos forces your hidden depths to surface, Scorpio. As your ruling planet Pluto stations retrograde in your 3rd House on Monday, mental obsessions intensify but Tuesday's Sun sextile Jupiter in your 8th House brings career money through a secret investor. Midweek, Venus squares Saturn in your 7th House on Wednesday, exposing relationship power struggles that demand boundary work. By Thursday, Mercury trine Neptune in your 5th House sparks romantic fantasy, and the weekend favors intimate connection as Mars trines Pluto Saturday. Wednesday is your power day because Venus squares Saturn clarifying partnership terms. Sunday is your worst day due to Moon opposition your Sun causing emotional volatility. Water sign Scorpio, journal your shadow insights daily. Follow for daily updates.
